summary: The proposed patch addresses the specific issue with LooseVersion and 'dev' suffixes but may not handle all edge cases related to version comparison.

issues.description: The patch uses a regex to match numeric parts of the version string, which may not cover all valid versioning schemes according to PEP 440.
There are no additional tests provided to ensure that the patch correctly handles various versioning scenarios, including those with 'dev', 'rc', and other pre-release tags.
